levels.label: Developing
levels.description: Touches are missing, fewer than four, or spaced at a fixed daily interval with no expansion.

levels.label: Meets
levels.description: At least four touches across the two weeks with gaps that clearly expand over time.

levels.label: Exceeds
levels.description: Expanding-interval schedule that also adapts the next gap to how well each recall went.

levels.label: Developing
levels.description: One or more touches are re-reading or passive review ('go over the notes') rather than producing from memory.

levels.label: Meets
levels.description: Every touch names a concrete retrieval action — recall, self-quiz, redo, or teach-aloud.

levels.label: Exceeds
levels.description: Retrieval actions escalate in difficulty and each ends with a check against the source (desirable difficulty).

levels.label: Developing
levels.description: No interleaved session, or no elaboration prompt — the plan blocks one topic and only tests recall.

levels.label: Meets
levels.description: Includes at least one interleaved late session and one 'why/how does this connect' elaboration prompt.

levels.label: Exceeds
levels.description: Interleaving pairs genuinely confusable topics and the elaboration prompt links the new material to specific prior knowledge.
